def num_comm_div(a, b):
    # Find the minimum of the two numbers
    min_num = min(a, b)

    # Initialize the count of common divisors
    count = 0

    # Iterate from 1 to the minimum of the two numbers
    for i in range(1, min_num + 1):
        # Check if both numbers are divisible by i
        if a % i == 0 and b % i == 0:
            # Increment the count of common divisors
            count += 1

    # Return the count of common divisors
